title: Unexpected Entertainment
author: straitofamerica
selftext:
I wanted to show what can be done through the Chatgpt web chat with GPT-6 Pro and the web UI.

This game was almost entirely built with an MCP tunnel, including all of the non-synty assets in the video. Astra also built the fully playable game, menus and UIs through an MCP from the web chat. Gpt-6 pro would often work for hours making changes through the MCP with a single prompt. It felt like I got more usage through that than I did through the codex CLI on a 20x account.

Opus 5.5 was used to make the trailer and clean a few things up, but nearly all of the 'humor' was written by the web chat with a few prompts. To give credit to Claude, when making the trailer it also went out and found sound clips of the Greatest President Ever and spliced them into the video.

On the humor side of things Claude was basically a massive buzz kill, but Astra was happy to research and add vibe-coded humor into everything - even the billboards are ridiculous in the game.
